fields.topPerformers: ={{ $json.results.playerResults.filter(p => p.placement <= 3).map(p => ({ id: p.playerId, name: p.playerName, placement: p.placement, score: p.statistics.score })) }}

parameters.responseBody:
={{ {
  success: true,
  matchId: $json.matchId,
  status: 'completed',
  playerCount: $json.results.playerResults.length,
  winner: $json.results.winner,
  duration: $json.results.duration,
  rankingsUpdated: $node["Update Player Rankings"].json.success,
  achievementsUnlocked: $node["Unlock Achievements"].json.unlocks?.length || 0,
  rewardsDistributed: $json.rewardDistributions.length
} }}
